# Control options

33 options. Set them in the daemon's `.conf` file or `appsettings.json`. Full reference: [configuration.md](../configuration.md). All areas: [index](README.md).

Daemon says which server reads it. Reload says whether `.reload config` applies it: `live` is applied to the running server, `restart` keeps its value until the next start, `start` is read once when the daemon starts.

## `World:Control:MapFeed`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AnomaliesUnowned` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Whether the anomaly ring keeps notices that carry no owner identity (`AnomalyNotice.Origin` null). The ledger is process-wide, and a notice with an owner is kept only when the owner is this world; a reporter that passes none cannot be told apart, so it is kept only when this is true. Default true, because the daemon runs one world per process; tests that run several worlds in one process set it false. |
| `Enabled` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Serve the map feed on a local Windows named pipe. A connected tool may watch one map at a time (players, bots, creatures, game objects, creature splines, bot routes, loaded grids) and ask for line of sight, ground height, a navigation path or an under-map verdict between two points of a map; nothing it sends changes the world, and a question never loads a tile. The pipe admits only the account the daemon runs as and SYSTEM, refuses network clients, and is not created on other operating systems. While nobody is subscribed the feed does no work on the world thread. Default off. |
| `MaxConnections` | `int` | `2` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | The most tools connected at once: one pipe instance each, all created at start. A tool beyond the limit finds the pipe busy and is not served. 1 to 16. |
| `MaxEntitiesPerFrame` | `int` | `4096` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | The most entities one frame carries. Players and bots come first, then creatures (moving ones before idle ones) and game objects; the rest are counted as truncated in the frame. 16 to 65536. |
| `MaxHz` | `int` | `5` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | The most frames per second any subscription gets; a tool asking for more is given this rate. 1 to 60. |

## `World:Control:MapFeed:Actions`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AllowOnLiveServer` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | A second, deliberate opt-in: let `Enabled` take effect on the live server (`ARCANECORE_LIVE_SERVER=1`, set by the live launcher, which runs the server as Development). The daemon then logs a warning at start. Default off. |
| `AuditDirectory` | `string` | `null` | text | World | start | The directory of the durable audit file; null: `logs` beside the working directory (where the server log goes). |
| `AuditLocalDurable` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Also append local actions to the durable audit file (`atlas-web-audit.jsonl`). Web actions are always recorded. Default on. |
| `BulkConfirmAbove` | `int` | `1` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | A template applied to more targets than this needs a confirm code. 0 to 50. Default 1. |
| `Deny` | `List<string>` | `[]` | a list: numbered keys 0, 1, 2, ...; each value is text | World | start | Command paths no actor may run, local included (same matching as `PublicDeny`). Default none. |
| `Enabled` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Accept action requests on the map feed (World:Control:MapFeed:Enabled must be on too). Default off. |
| `LocalAccountId` | `int?` | `null` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | The account id the local actor counts as for "my own character" checks (`.atlas tele` of a player at GameMaster level). Set here, in the world's configuration, never by a tool. Default none: the local actor has no account. |
| `LocalBurst` | `int` | `20` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Local actor: burst. Default 20. |
| `LocalPerSecond` | `int` | `10` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Local actor: actions per second. Default 10. |
| `LocalSecurity` | `AccountSecurity` | `Administrator` | Player \| Moderator \| GameMaster \| Administrator | World | start | The security the local actor (whoever controls the daemon's Windows account on this machine; the world sees "the daemon account") runs commands at. Player to Administrator: there is no Console level, so the local actor is never the true console. Default Administrator. Values: `Player`, `Moderator`, `GameMaster`, `Administrator`. |
| `PublicAllowModeration` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Let web actors run `.ban` and `.unban`: removes them from `PublicDeny`. Default off. |
| `PublicDeny` | `List<string>` | `["account", "server shutdown", "server restart", "server idleshutdown", "server idlerestart", "reload", "hotcode", "hotmodule", "botctl raw", "ban", "unban"]` | a list: numbered keys 0, 1, 2, ...; each value is text | World | start | Command paths no web actor may run, matched on the path the command table resolved (so an abbreviation cannot dodge a rule): a path is denied when it starts with an entry's words ("ban" denies "ban account", "botctl raw" denies "botctl raw send"). The default list is the account, lifecycle, reload, hot-code, raw bot and moderation commands. |
| `PublicMaxSecurity` | `AccountSecurity` | `GameMaster` | Player \| Moderator \| GameMaster \| Administrator | World | start | The highest security a web actor runs at, whatever its account has. Default GameMaster. Values: `Player`, `Moderator`, `GameMaster`, `Administrator`. |
| `SettleSeconds` | `int` | `30` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Seconds an action waits for its command to settle (a command that holds itself open) before the answer goes out. 1 to 600. Default 30. |
| `WebAuditDays` | `int` | `90` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Days the durable audit file's rotated copies are kept. 1 to 3650. Default 90. |
| `WebBurst` | `int` | `5` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Each web actor: burst. Default 5. |
| `WebLogin` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Accept web actors (tickets issued by the public Atlas listener's login). Needs the true-console predicate (`CommandContextConsole`, design 1.7) in this build: without it the channel logs a warning and refuses web actors. Default off. |
| `WebLoginMinSecurity` | `AccountSecurity` | `Moderator` | Player \| Moderator \| GameMaster \| Administrator | World | start | The lowest account security a web login is accepted for. Default Moderator. Values: `Player`, `Moderator`, `GameMaster`, `Administrator`. |
| `WebPerSecond` | `int` | `2` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Each web actor: actions per second. Default 2. |

## `World:Control:MapFeed:Web`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ClientAccount` | `string` | `null` | text | World | start | The one Windows account allowed to open the web pipe: a SID (`S-1-5-21-...`) or an account name (`MACHINE\atlas-public`). Required when `Enabled` is set; without it the pipe is not created. A group or built-in principal is refused (Everyone, Authenticated Users, SYSTEM, LOCAL/NETWORK SERVICE, `BUILTIN\`, `NT AUTHORITY\` and `NT SERVICE\` names, `S-1-5-32-*`, any account with a RID below 1000), and so is the daemon's own account: `Problems` checks the text at start-up, the pipe checks the resolved SID. |
| `Enabled` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Serve the web pipe (World:Control:MapFeed:Enabled must be on too). Default off. |
| `MaxConnections` | `int` | `2` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | The most web connections at once, independent of the local pipe's count. 1 to 8. Default 2. |

## `World:Control:PacketTools`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AllowOutsideDevelopment` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | A second, deliberate opt-in: let Enabled take effect when the host environment is not Development (Staging, Production or unset). The tools then start with a warning naming the environment. Never set this on a server players use. Default off. |
| `Enabled` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Offer the packet tools on the map feed's pipe (World:Control:MapFeed:Enabled must be on too). A connected tool may then run console commands with the console's Administrator authority, inject client opcodes as an online player or bot, send server opcodes to its client and watch its packets. Every console line, injection and send is logged and counted. Refused, with a warning at start, outside the Development environment unless AllowOutsideDevelopment is also true. Changing it needs a restart. Default off. |

## `World:Control:Pipe`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Enabled` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Accept console commands on a local Windows named pipe. Each line runs exactly like a line typed at the console: on the world thread, Administrator authority, no character, logged and GM-audited as the console. The pipe admits only the account the daemon runs as and SYSTEM, refuses network clients, and is not created on other operating systems. Default off. |
| `IdleTimeoutSeconds` | `int` | `120` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Seconds a connected client may stay silent before the daemon closes the connection (frees the single pipe instance). |
| `MaxLineLength` | `int` | `4096` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | The longest command line in bytes; a longer line closes the connection without running anything. |
| `Name` | `string` | `"arcanecore-world-{pid}"` | text | World | start | The pipe name (without `\\.\pipe\`); `{pid}` is replaced by the world process id, so two daemons on one machine never share a name. The daemon refuses to serve a name another process already created. Letters, digits, '.', '_', '-' and the token only. |
